reason: MRKR released no DICOM equipment tags. ManufacturerModelName, DeviceSerialNumber and StationName are absent from every delivered table; a case-insensitive search of image.parquet and of the identical MRKR_image_metadata.csv for manufacturer, model, serial number, station, institution, kVp, exposure, tube current and slice thickness returns no matching column at all, so what is missing is the acquisition-parameter class and not the image metadata as a whole. Of the 19 columns those files do carry, none records how the radiograph was acquired; laterality, view_position, weight_bearing, inverted, horizontal_flip, arthroplasty, L_KLG_inference and R_KLG_inference are all released and are used elsewhere in this package.

MRKR released no InstitutionName or InstitutionalDepartmentName tag, and no site identifier appears in any delivered table. Site cannot be approximated from patient identifiers, which are de-identified surrogates.
